function: Learns RIS phase shifts (FL-DDPG) to minimize the position error bound while keeping communication capacity above a minimum, i.e. RIS passive beamforming for ISAC (pp. 5-6).
system: 28 GHz OFDM ISAC: BS with 4 antennas, vehicle target with 4 antennas, one passive reflecting RIS of 64 elements with discrete phases (pp. 4, 9).
method: Reinforcement learning: DDPG with epsilon-greedy exploration (FL-DDPG), actor-critic with target networks and replay buffer, trained in simulation, then forward pass at use (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Own geometric simulator: LoS plus RIS-reflected paths from array responses, path-loss exponents 3.2 and 2.2, shadowing, small-scale fading; no standard or measured channel (pp. 4, 9).
test_conditions: One fixed geometry (BS, RIS, one target); sweeps over RIS elements, RIS bits, BS power, rate requirement and channel error; no unseen scenario reported (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: PSO, GA, no-RIS system; learned: TD3, SAC, PPO, and DDPG without the epsilon-greedy strategy (pp. 10-11).
metrics: Position error bound (m), communication capacity (bit/s/Hz), execution time (s), reward convergence over training episodes (pp. 5, 10-11).
complexity: Order of complexity for training and online inference in layer widths (p. 8); execution time versus RIS size, lower than PSO and GA (pp. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 9: "The path loss exponent of the direct channel is"; own geometric LoS plus RIS-reflected channel with chosen exponents; no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "We set that BS is located at (900, 100, 20) and the target is located at (500, 500, 0)"; one fixed geometry, sweeps of RIS size, bits, power or CSI error are not new conditions; no adaptation reported.
q3_support: p. 10: "We compare the FL-DDPG with heuristic particle swarm optimization (PSO), and genetic algorithm (GA)" and "We compare FL-DDPG with the state-of-art DRL methods", on position error bound and capacity (Figs. 8, 10).
q4_support: p. 8: "the overall complexity of the proposed FL-DDPG algorithm" given as an O(...) expression; p. 10: "FL-DDPG exhibits lower execution times compared to the PSO and GA".
q5_support: p. 9: "The proposed FL-DDPG is evaluated via extensive RIS assisted 6G V2X simulations"; no code or data link; p. 12: "we will continuously update and adjust the algorithm using real measurement data" is future work.
notes: Included as area 5: the objective is the position error bound under a communication-rate constraint, so it is ISAC and not localization alone. DDPG without epsilon-greedy is an ablation and not counted as learned baseline; TD3, SAC and PPO count. Table I and Figs. 5-12 read as page images; first page holds title and DOI.
